svc13.title: Availability by period
svc13.metaNone: Monthly reporting periods. No objective is in force, so each period shows its measurement without a verdict.
svc13.periodField: Choose a start and an end date.
svc13.errorTitle: The measurements could not be read.
svc13.emptyTitle: No period has been measured for this process.
svc13.emptyAllTitle: No period in this range has been measured.
svc13.emptyNever: Monthly reporting periods. The process was designated on {d} and has no measurement since.
svc13.emptySince: Monthly reporting periods. The last period measured ended on {d}.
svc13.caption: Availability by period, {p}
svc13.sortNote: By process, then by period, latest first. A period not measured never sorts with a period met.
svc13.gapDetail: The window was incomplete for {p}. Not compared with an objective
svc13.unmeasuredDetail: No measurement for this period. Not compared with an objective

svc14.title: Locations and route dependencies
svc14.meta: Each critical service must run in at least two independent failure domains. The public verification route must answer while the rest is down.
svc14.errorTitle: The location records could not be read.
svc14.fAtHelp: The 15-minute interval holding this time. Last recorded: {t}.
svc14.depTitle: The public verification route depends on
svc14.depMeta: The release check records the list. Each sweep evaluates every component again.
svc14.locMeta: Recorded every 15 minutes. Two machines in one domain count as one domain.
svc14.locSort: Services with a problem first, then by name.
svc14.noneDetail: No location has been recorded for this service in {span}.
svc14.oneDetailIncident: Served only from {place} since {at}, during incident {incident}
svc14.depLine: {n} of {total} components are not shown to be independent.
svc14.depDetail: {n} exceptions are open and acknowledged. They wait for a decision on whether the verification route must answer while RightOne.Api or the primary database is down.
svc14.cIndep: Independent while the rest is down
svc14.depSort: Components not shown independent first, then by name.
svc21.kRecord: Open the form to record a translation
svc21.title: Translation register
svc21.meta: Vietnamese is authoritative. A translation is current only while the Vietnamese version it was approved against is in force.
svc21.recordedTitle: The {lang} translation is recorded against version {v}.
svc21.recordedText: It stays current while Vietnamese version {v} is in force.
svc21.nsTitle: Type a content key to see its translations.
svc21.nsText: A content key is the name the publishing module gives the content, for example PREMISES_SERVICE_TERMS for the RightOne Player terms for premises. The register does not list every key.
svc21.errTitle: The translations could not be read.
svc21.authoritative: Where a translation and the Vietnamese text differ, the Vietnamese text is the one relied on.
svc21.sortNote: Current translations first. Within each group, the latest approved first.
svc21.emptyTitle: No translation has been recorded for this content.
svc21.emptyText: Readers are offered the Vietnamese text.
svc21.note: A superseded translation is not published as current.
svc21.noteDetail: A reader is offered the Vietnamese text in force until a new translation is approved.
svc21.formNote: A translation is recorded with the approved Vietnamese version it was translated from.
svc21.sourceHelp: Only an approved version can be the source.
svc21.notApproved: Version {v} is not approved, so a translation of it cannot be published.
svc21.alreadyText: The {lang} translation against version {v} is already in the register. Each language has one translation per Vietnamese version.
